aboutHighlight.title: shamelessly delicious
paragraphs:
[brand]tigre tigre[/brand] has one mission and it's simple -
to be the nagging thought you want to satisfy.

Our oil is greasy. Like, really.
The garlic is dangerous and [underline]crunchy[/underline].
[marker]The heat[/marker] is worthy of tripe soup.

We have no qualms about what you put us on.
We only care if you think about us after.

These are the first 1000 jars of [brand]tigre tigre[/brand].
We released them without design, without a pretty label, and without [underline]pretensions[/underline].

But this is [circle]our most important[/circle] label.
The one with the QR code.
It leads you to a feedback form, because even before we think about visuals, we want to be sure of the most important thing – the [marker]taste[/marker].

After them, there will be a real label, large production,
and fewer apologies.

But this here is the beginning.
The version where taste matters more than packaging and [marker]your opinion[/marker] is part of the product.

howToHighlight.title: How to eat it?
paragraphs:
There's no right way.
There's [circle]your way[/circle].

Put a spoonful on [underline]eggs[/underline], pasta, noodles, or rice.
Works with meat, vegetables, and anything that needs a little [marker]heat[/marker]
and you want to give it a lot of [underline]character[/underline].

You can mix it in.
You can pour it on top.
You can eat it straight with [underline]bread[/underline].

[brand]tigre tigre[/brand] isn't measured in grams and recipes.
It's eaten by eye, by gut, and [marker]without shame[/marker].
